messages.subject: mapOutput error
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to display a leaflet map inside a Shiny application but I keep getting the following error when the app loads the rCharts library. It seems to be related to the mapOutput function inside rCharts but I can't seem to find the issue.

If I use the sample code from Rammath

require(rCharts)
require(shiny)

runApp(list(
  ui = pageWithSidebar(
    headerPanel("Title"),
    sidebarPanel("MyApp" ),
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Interactive Map", mapOutput("myChart"))
      )
    )
  ),
  server = function(input, output){
    output$myChart <- renderMap({
      map3 <- Leaflet$new()
      map3$setView(c(19.4329,- 99.1331), zoom = 8)
      map3
    })
  }
))

The following error appears:

Error in system.file("libraries", lib, package = package) : 
  object 'package' not found

Any ideas of how to fix it? I am running R 3.1.0 on a 64-bit Windows machine.

Thanks,

Carlos

messages.subject: Re: mapOutput error
parts:
Hi,

chartOutput("myChart", 'leaflet') instead of mapOutput("myChart") seems to be working.
